description: Supabase Auth. The session is established by verifying the JWT with getClaims() rather than decoding a cookie with getSession() — the latter is forgeable and Supabase's own types say so. Roles live in a `profiles` table with no insert or update policy, so nothing holding a publishable key can mint one.

env.name: AUTH_ALLOWED_DOMAINS
env.note: internal mode only. Comma-separated email domains permitted to sign in. Enforced on EVERY request, so removing a domain locks out sessions that already exist.
